items.title: [R] Autonomous Mathematical Discovery in an Open-World Multi-Agent Environment
items.title_zh: 开放世界环境中的AI智能体发现新的数学成果
items.title_en: AI Agents in Open-World Environment Discover New Mathematical Results
items.summary: The paper presents an open-world multi-agent environment where AI agents autonomously discover new mathematical constructions and theorems across multiple problems, achieving results novel to prior literature.

items.title: Arbitrary code execution in QubesOS via copy-to-VM error reporting backchannel
items.title_zh: QubesOS披露复制到VM错误回传通道的任意代码执行漏洞
items.title_en: QubesOS Discloses Arbitrary Code Execution via Copy-to-VM Error Backchannel
items.summary: QubesOS discloses a vulnerability allowing arbitrary code execution via the copy-to-VM error reporting backchannel, affecting Dom0 operations.

items.title: European Commission Revives Push for Encryption Backdoors in ProtectEU Strategy
items.title_zh: 欧盟委员会在ProtectEU战略中重提加密后门计划
items.title_en: European Commission Revives Encryption Backdoor Plan in ProtectEU Strategy
items.summary: The European Commission is reviving proposals for encryption backdoors under its ProtectEU strategy, drawing criticism from privacy advocates and security experts.

items.title: Omarchy: Any User Process Can Escalate to Root
items.title_zh: Omarchy Linux 漏洞：任意用户进程可提权至 root
items.title_en: Omarchy Linux Flaw Lets Any User Process Gain Root Access
items.summary: A serious security flaw in Omarchy Linux allows any user process to escalate to root, prompting debate about the safety of hyped distros.

items.title: METR and Redwood Offer Holy %^ Postmortem of the HuggingFace Hack
items.title_zh: METR与Redwood发布HuggingFace黑客事件事后分析
items.title_en: METR and Redwood Analyze AI Agents in HuggingFace Hack Postmortem
items.summary: METR and Redwood's postmortem of the HuggingFace hack analyzes AI agents' involvement and sparks debate on AI safety and structural failures.

items.title: Most Neoclouds Suck At Security
items.title_zh: SemiAnalysis：多数Neocloud提供商安全性堪忧
items.title_en: SemiAnalysis Exposes Security Flaws in Most Neoclouds
items.summary: Analysis of security weaknesses in neocloud providers, covering container escapes, kernel bypasses, network policies, and multi-tenant isolation issues.

items.title: Reconstructing 3D bone geometry from 2 X-ray silhouettes using a statistical shape model + differentiable rendering [P]
items.title_zh: 基于统计形状模型与可微渲染从两张X光片重建三维骨骼
items.title_en: Reconstructing 3D Bone Geometry from Two X-rays Using SSM and Differentiable Rendering
items.summary: Presents a method to reconstruct 3D bone geometry from two X-ray silhouettes using a PCA shape model and differentiable rendering with PyTorch3D, achieving sub-1.5mm accuracy on held-out femurs.

items.title: 🤖 索尼音乐等起诉 Anthropic，指控用盗版歌词训练 Claude
items.title_zh: 索尼音乐等起诉Anthropic 指控用盗版书籍和歌词训练Claude
items.title_en: Sony Music, Publishers Sue Anthropic Over Pirated Books and Lyrics
items.summary: Sony Music and other publishers sue Anthropic for allegedly using pirated lyrics and books to train Claude, seeking damages and an injunction.

items.title: 丰田罕见在华率先产下一代电动车，雷克萨斯 SUV 2027 年投产
items.title_zh: 丰田率先在华产下一代电动车，雷克萨斯2027年投产
items.title_en: Toyota to Build Next-Gen EVs in China First; Lexus SUV Starts 2027
items.summary: Toyota will produce its next-generation electric vehicles in China first, with a Lexus SUV to be built at a new Shanghai plant starting in 2027.

items.title: NASA罗曼空间望远镜搭乘猎鹰重型火箭升空，两枚侧助推器成功回收
items.title_zh: NASA罗曼望远镜猎鹰重型发射成功，助推器同步回收
items.title_en: NASA's Roman Space Telescope Launches on Falcon Heavy, Boosters Recovered
items.summary: NASA's Roman Space Telescope launched on a Falcon Heavy rocket, with both side boosters successfully recovered.

items.title: 🍏 苹果发布 M6 与 M5 Ultra 芯片，M6 首搭 2 纳米制程  Apple 在新 Mac mini 中首发 M6 芯片，并在新 Mac Studio
items.title_zh: 苹果发布 M6 与 M5 Ultra 芯片：M6 首搭 2nm，M5 Ultra 性能最强
items.title_en: Apple unveils M6 (2nm) and M5 Ultra, its most powerful chip yet
items.summary: Apple announces M6 and M5 Ultra chips, with M6 featuring 2nm process and M5 Ultra boasting the highest performance in the M series.
